name: Shellback crab
sig: Pincer snap; shell spin you guard to flip it
worlds: Vael II, Hangar, Market, Salt Harbour, Glass Dunes

name: Skitter swarm
sig: Ripple rush: the flock pours in one by one
worlds: Desert, Lorn, Buried, Moon Foundry, Underside

name: Ring centipede
sig: Coils round you into a living wall, then tightens
worlds: Buried, Spheres, Fallen Ring, Eclipse, Waterfall

name: Bellows toad
sig: Throat swells, lobs a spore glob; belly-flop quake
worlds: Lorn, City-Shaft, Waterfall, Home*

name: Horn lizard
sig: Brass-horn blare shoves you to its partner
worlds: City-Shaft, Buried, Market, Eclipse, Moon Foundry

name: Stilt heron
sig: Neck draws back into an S, then a 5 m beak spear
worlds: Desert, Vael, Lorn, White Mangrove

name: Pearl roller
sig: Curls into its shell and bowls at you; guard bounces it
worlds: Spheres, Hangar, Salt Harbour, Space City

name: Root knot
sig: Roots run under you and drag you in for the lash
worlds: Lorn, Lorn II, Viridel, White Mangrove

name: Lantern jelly
sig: Its lanterns ward nearby foes; pop them first
worlds: Vael II, Lorn II, Spheres, Underwater, Fallen Ring

name: Signal moth
sig: Wings open wide: a white flash blinds if you look
worlds: Lorn II, Viridel, Market, Antennas, Space City

name: Sky ray
sig: Banks, then skims a low lane; parry grounds it
worlds: Vael, Vael II, Hangar, Glass Dunes, Underwater, Underside

name: Mound worm
sig: A mound circles you, stops, and it erupts under you
worlds: Desert, Buried, Glass Dunes

name: Lamp tripod
sig: Searchlight locks on, then a harpoon bolt down the beam
worlds: Desert*, City-Shaft, Buried, Underwater, Fallen Ring

name: Crucible cart
sig: Tips its crucible: a pour of burning slag that stays
worlds: Hangar, Buried, Moon Foundry, Overnight Train*

name: Bell walker
sig: Rears and tolls: rings of sound to jump, one by one
worlds: Vael II (one), Market, Salt Harbour, Underside

name: Ring drone
sig: Plates part, a harpoon line reels you in
worlds: City-Shaft, Hangar, Spheres, Antennas, Space City

name: Furnace brute
sig: Raises both fists for the slam; a quake runs out
worlds: Viridel, Glass Dunes, Waterfall, Lorn II

name: Ink blot
sig: Coils and lunges; spits a glob if you keep away
worlds: every world, few and early

name: Shade
sig: Ink sword: cut, feint and thrust; parry to riposte
worlds: Lorn II, City-Shaft, Hangar, Spheres, Glass Dunes

name: Antler hound
sig: A shadow on the ground rises; antlers dip, it pounces
worlds: Eclipse, White Mangrove, Spheres, Market

name: Marionette
sig: Strings drop onto a creature and drive it; cut them
worlds: Market, Underside, Salt Harbour, Spheres
